findings.title: Content Security Policy allows unsafe-inline
findings.evidence: The fictional response includes unsafe-inline in its CSP.
findings.fix: Review whether nonces or hashes can replace unsafe-inline.

findings.title: HSTS header not present
findings.evidence: Strict-Transport-Security was absent from the fictional homepage response.
findings.fix: If HTTPS is enabled across intended hosts, consider a suitable HSTS policy.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy header not present
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy was absent from the fictional homepage response.
findings.fix: Set a privacy-conscious Referrer-Policy appropriate for the site.

findings.title: Potential unsafe DOM sink in sample source
findings.evidence: Fictional sample source uses innerHTML; this pattern alone does not prove exploitability.
findings.fix: Prefer textContent for plain text and review whether untrusted input can reach this sink.

limitations: These are illustrative review leads, not confirmed vulnerabilities. Missing headers and code patterns do not prove a site is exploitable.
